title: VTC Groups — Join — payload
description: A member joins an open group at once, or asks to join a group that takes requests; where the group issues credentials, they are offered a membership credential issued by the group's DID. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTC Groups — Join — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/join/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/join/0.1#response.

outcome.description: `joined`: a member now. `requested`: a request awaits a manager. `optOutWithdrawn`: the caller's opt-out of a dynamic group is undone, but its rule does not admit them now; they become a member when it does.

credentialId.description: The membership credential offered, or null when the group issues none or the outcome is `requested`.
